title: agitatedVessel operation
description: A stirred vessel whose shaft power is computed from the Metzner-Otto average shear rate (Chhabra & Richardson, Ch. 8) and enters the energy balance as the Work item W_shaft_kW.  The liquid's flow curve is the property dictionary's (Newtonian by absence); the impeller's k_s and K_p are an asset record of kind impeller; the vessel and the speed are this block's.  Refused by name: a yield-stress, shear-thickening, viscoelastic or time-dependent fluid; a transitional Reynolds number.

impeller.title: Impeller
impeller.description: The impeller is an asset record (kind impeller) in constant/assets/ or data/standards/assets/.  Give ONE speed: N or tipSpeed.

D.title: Impeller diameter
D.description: Default: D_T / (1 + clearanceRatio) from the record.

thermalMode.title: Thermal mode
thermalMode.description: isothermal (default): the jacket removes the dissipated shaft power, T_out = T_in, the duty Q_kW = -W_shaft_kW is published.  adiabatic: the contents warm up.

outsideCorrelationWindow.title: A geometry outside the correlation's data
outsideCorrelationWindow.description: Declares, with a reason, that the impeller geometry is outside the data range of the correlation that gives K_p (eq. 8.7).  Without it such a vessel is refused.
